---
# A starting point for EPISODIC_MAIL_TEMPLATE_NEW_CLUSTERS: the body of the
# email sent when a detection run finds new clusters. Copy it, adapt it,
# and point the environment variable at your copy; preview it with
# episodic_mail_template_preview("new_clusters", template_path = "...").
#
# An email is not a web page. Email clients drop <style> blocks and
# scripts, so every style here is inline, taken from d$mail_style (built
# from the instance palette, the dashboard's own colours and font), and
# `minimal: true` keeps Quarto from adding Bootstrap and JavaScript that
# no inbox would run. Images embedded in the HTML are blocked by Gmail and
# Outlook, so this template carries text and tables only.
pagetitle: "EpiSODIC"
format:
  html:
    minimal: true
    embed-resources: true
params:
  data_path: "mail_data.rds"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
d <- readRDS(params$data_path)
lang <- d$lang
s <- d$mail_style
tr <- function(key, ...) EpiSODIC:::episodic_tr(key, lang = lang, ...)
esc <- function(x) EpiSODIC:::episodic_html_escape(x)
at <- function(css) EpiSODIC:::episodic_mail_style_attr(css)
# Every number is written the way `lang` writes one; a value that was not
# measured is NA and shows as a dash, never as a zero.
num <- function(x, digits = NULL) {
  if (is.na(x)) tr("misc.dash") else EpiSODIC:::episodic_format_number(x, digits = digits, lang = lang)
}
```

```{r body, results='asis'}
rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d$clusters)), function(i) {
  row <- d$clusters[i, ]
  ref <- if (is.na(row$url)) {
    esc(row$ref)
  } else {
    paste0("<a href='", esc(row$url), "'", at(s$link), ">", esc(row$ref), "</a>")
  }
  centre <- paste0("<td", at(paste0("text-align:center;", s$td)), ">")
  paste0(
    "<tr>",
    "<td", at(s$td), ">", ref, "</td>",
    "<td", at(s$td), ">", esc(row$pathogen), "</td>",
    "<td", at(s$td), ">", esc(row$location), "</td>",
    centre, esc(row$period), "</td>",
    centre, num(row$n_cases), "</td>",
    centre, num(row$priority_score, digits = 0), "</td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
}, character(1))

header <- function(key, align) {
  paste0("<th", at(paste0("text-align:", align, ";", s$th)), ">", esc(tr(key)), "</th>")
}

footer <- if (is.null(d$dashboard_url)) {
  ""
} else {
  paste0(
    "<p", at(s$paragraph), "><a href='", esc(d$dashboard_url), "'", at(s$link), ">",
    esc(tr("notif.open_dashboard")), "</a></p>"
  )
}

cat(
  "```{=html}\n",
  "<div", at(s$body), ">",
  # Your organisation's letterhead goes here.
  "<h2", at(s$heading), ">", esc(d$title), "</h2>",
  "<table", at(s$table), ">",
  "<tr", at(s$head_row), ">",
  header("column.id", "left"),
  header("column.pathogen", "left"),
  header("column.place", "left"),
  header("column.period", "center"),
  header("column.cases", "center"),
  header("column.priority", "center"),
  "</tr>",
  paste(rows, collapse = "\n"),
  "</table>",
  footer,
  "<p", at(s$muted), ">EpiSODIC ", esc(d$package_version), "</p>",
  "</div>\n",
  "```\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
